message.description: Unsafe type assertion: type 'Omit<Required<Readonly<{ hello: "world"; foo: "bar"; }>>, "foo">' is more narrow than the original type.
message.help: The original expression has type `string`, and the assertion changes it to `Omit<Required<Readonly<{ hello: "world"; foo: "bar"; }>>, "foo">`. Use a type guard to narrow the value before asserting a more specific type.
